Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-chikyukko-kakashi/

Experience quiet Japanese culture under wide open skies! Create your own scarecrow from harvested rice straw and arrange them in the rice paddies.

【Participation fee】¥5,000 per person (includes craft materials, meal ingredients, guide service, and insurance)

【Capacity】6 people

【Guide】Chikyukko Farm staff

【What to bring】Wellington boots, work gloves, hat, towel, change of clothes (recommended), drinking water, old clothes to dress the scarecrow in
location: 集合 飯能市下加治の田んぼ（イーグルバス「飯能靖和病院」下車徒歩8分）
summary: Scarecrow-Making in the Rice Paddies and Open-Air Farm Lunch
